selection: Deterministic hash ordering within task or instruction strata, round robin across strata. No answer-based selection or replacement.
execution: Paired questions, alternating level order. One generated answer per question and level. Identical original prompts and token limits.
scope: Samples with original upstream grading; not full leaderboard benchmark scores.
timeout_policy: Stop launching pairs when insufficient estimated time remains. Preserve interrupted, failed and token-limited attempts. No silent retries or omissions.
metrics: Native evaluated prefill tokens / prefill seconds; (output_tokens-1) / decode seconds; full latency, TTFT, draft acceptance, handoff and resource usage. Separate warmup and end-to-end client metrics.
